dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave trailing edge curve extending from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40-degree slope relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, large-radius convex arc extending from the cranial peak to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, high-thickness beak extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel junction of the melon and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform green-cyan monochromatic texture and lighting across the entire visible surface.
